method: headless Chrome DOM + geometry + persisted-state mirror only; no vision. Screenshots are hashed mirrors, not inspected visually.

fixtureScrutiny.a: Only setup seeding mutates state: fixtures derived from docs/evidence/yard-mature.json before encoding (research ranks, Data balance, Signal lab removed for deterministic balances, storeUnits recomputed as the store sum). No src changes; every action is a real UI click/tap/scroll through dispatch -> applyCommand.
fixtureScrutiny.b: Documented in this probe header, the FIXTURES table and results.json.
fixtureScrutiny.c: Seeded envelopes pass the game's full decodeSave/repairRegistration/validateSim; the 00-open steps assert the loaded mirror matches the seed. No invariant weakened or bypassed.
fixtureScrutiny.d: No action faked by injection; localStorage read only as the game's own persistence mirror (written on every ok dispatch).

findings.detail: App.tsx showResearch() offers the Research destination only once Data exists or a node is known (spec 5.5). A fresh yard therefore shows a disabled rail slot with the reason 'Needs data' (desktop) or no dock Research button (phone). The panel's no-data state is demonstrated the reachable way: one node owned, balance spent to 0. #58 does not alter this gate (App.tsx is outside its ownership).
findings.source: src/ui/App.tsx showResearch; src/ui/shell/Shell.tsx ShellRail reason; src/ui/Hud.tsx DockButtons

findings.detail: The mature yard's Signal lab produces 2 Data every 15s, which would drift the no-data/partial balances mid-observation. The probe removes that one machine and its two routes from the derived fixtures (references pruned exactly like the game's repairRegistration) so balances stay fixed. The completed fixture keeps the full mature yard verbatim.
findings.source: src/game/content/defs.ts BLUEPRINTS.signalLab + RECIPES R11; src/game/persistence/save.ts repairRegistration
